activities.activity_description: Create documentation to guide users in building custom modules per Spring standards.
Package the custom module as an uber-jar using Spring Boot.
Host the uber-jar in HDFS for container deployment.
Add native WebSocket support for full-duplex communication.
Evaluate and integrate npm-cache for CI dependency caching.
Configure Gradle to run distributed JVM tests.

activities.activity_name: Switch to Command Task for Builds
activities.activity_description: Replace Artifactory Gradle task with a command task invoking ./gradlew.
Run CI builds without embedded Hadoop to validate configurations.
Activate Gradle's maxParallelForks for parallel test execution.

Configure Bamboo Windows agent for integration tests with services and PowerShell.
